old_problem: Copied selectors do not establish OCP module/service coverage; proprietary TX/RX and severity semantics are unproven, and no disposable OCP transaction consumes poison or protects management/storage/fabric paths.
disposition_reason: Module mappings are parameterizable, but the AMD pcieerror flag contract and safe consumer/outcome semantics are core. PCIe poison rules cannot identify this tool's TX/RX perspective or guarantee the correctable label. ED-03/05/15/16 forbid guessing these values or risking the only OCP control path. Pending/BLOCKED remains until vendor authority and an independent OCP service-recovery plan exist.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row68, same-row AI/history2468, PCIe companion, OCP endpoint/root poison case and next IOHUB row69.
Preserved each OCP module and separate TX/RX Poisoned-TLP checkpoints.
Required module/interface/service identity, independent OOB and disposable checksum traffic unique to OCP.
Bound verdict to exact AER source plus packet/I/O/application and service outcome.
No hardware, traffic poison, BIOS/HDT change, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: OCP Poisoned-TLP TX/RX consumer and service containment
test_case.purpose: For each required OCP module, verify separate authoritative TX/RX poison stimuli traverse isolated disposable traffic, reach the intended consumer and recover the interface and dependent services without persistent data impact.
required_package: Independent OOB plus disposable checksum-protected traffic
Requester/completer, AER and consumer/service outcome matrix
OCP device/link/service and configuration recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: Do not run the copied commands. After approval, isolate one mapped OCP path, baseline disposable traffic/AER/service health, execute one TX stimulus and close recovery, then separately RX; correlate source/requester/completer, checksum/application result and restored interface/services.
test_case.expected_result: Each flag affects the intended direction and disposable transaction; exact AER and approved consumer outcome occur; no unintended data change, fatal escalation, host reset, management loss or persistent OCP link/service fault remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without authoritative flags and consumer matrix. Tool PASS, generic logs, copied tuple, unconsumed poison, wrong source/direction, critical-service impact or incomplete recovery fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated OCP path with independent OOB and no production/persistent/cluster-control traffic.
One module, direction and disposable transaction at a time.
Abort on wrong source, out-of-scope corruption, service loss, reset, fatal escalation or link failure.
No automatic retry; preserve traffic and AER evidence.
expected_evidence: Vendor flags plus OCP identity/dependency map
Separate TX/RX source and consumer records
test_case.recovery: Stop injection/traffic, preserve checksums and AER logs, restore saved AER/BIOS/HDT state, recover the OCP device/interface over independent OOB and verify every dependent service. Execution remains blocked until all branches are approved.
